name: th.sxstatus
title: XuanTie extension status
summary: XuanTie extension status register for S-mode
notes: 原文同时将低 8 位列为 0、低 22 位列为 WPRI，存在歧义；低 22 位不作推断。THEADISAEE 不应清零，清零行为未定义。

fields.name: THEADISAEE
fields.summary: Controls availability of XThead extensions. Do not clear; clearing behavior is undefined.

regions.label: WPRI
regions.summary: Reserved by XTheadSxStatus 1.0; other extensions may define these bits.
